name: J. G. Strijdom
role: Prime Minister of South Africa from 1954 to 1958
contribution: A South African politician who served as the fifth prime minister of South Africa from 1954 until his death in 1958.

checks.lead: Johannes Gerhardus "Hans" Strijdom (14 July 1893 – 24 August 1958), nicknamed the Lion of Waterberg, was a South African politician who served as the fifth prime minister of South Africa from 1954 until his death in 1958.
